create_VIP_model: create a VIP model with ResNet50 encoder and hidden dimension 1024 for visual representation learning
run_VIP_forward: run the VIP model forward pass to convert input images into feature representations
compute_VIP_similarity: compute the similarity between two tensor representations using the VIP sim method
configure_VIP_encoder: configure a VIP model with a ViT encoder instead of ResNet by setting size to 0
optimize_VIP_encoder: optimize the VIP encoder parameters using the built-in Adam optimizer
